# Update both Debian maintainer templates as one packaging change

The human-authored packaging landing changes the maintainer in both the application and language-pack control.in templates. Fixed accepted templates keep Thunderbird Build & Release Team in both places. Preserve those paired owned templates when changing package contact metadata; reading them does not establish the metadata of a built or published package. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Debian package metadata.
